description: Machine-readable feature-parity registry (PyQt6 = canonical model; Tauri/React web app must match). Statuses: parity | gap (requires open issue) | exempt (requires reason) | api_only (API/WebSocket endpoint with no shell surface; requires reason, issue #8861). The 'tiles' arrays are GENERATED from src/config/models.yaml feature_id bindings by scripts/registry/generate_registry_artifacts.py (issue #9412). tools.bunkershot3d_workbench.title: BunkerShot3D designer workbench (W2 sole parameters, W3 sand condition, F0 dynamic-RFT shot, W7 metrics, playability window, bounce utilisation, animated sole load field, 3-D shot animation through the ADR-0027 viewport, linked scalar traces with a validity band, F1 sand-field cross-sections, A/B comparison, validity verdict)
tools.bunkershot3d_workbench.notes: Moved out of engines.load_and_simulate by #8618: the tile is a club-design workbench, not an engine load/simulate surface, and the two launcher tiles (bunkershot3d -> a notebook script, bunker_shot -> the GUI) were reconciled into this one entry point. The computation lives in src/tools/bunker_shot_gui/model.py, which imports no GUI toolkit and is the layer a React port would consume; no API route or web page exists yet. The visualization suite (epic #8699) keeps that split: shot3d.py and traces.py compute, render3d.py and render_traces.py draw headlessly through matplotlib, and viewport_widgets.py only wires them to a canvas. A React port would consume shot3d.viewport_payload, which is the backend-neutral ADR-0027 ViewportOverlayPayload and carries the envelope status and fidelity tier in its metadata so any renderer can stamp its own frames. The F1 sand cut (#8710, #8711) keeps the same split and adds one constraint a port must honour: the field carries its fidelity tier and validity status as data covered by a SHA-256 over the provenance and the arrays together, so any client that renders a field must read the standing out of the file rather than out of its filename, and must refuse a field whose digest does not match.
